output.summary: A red alga of rocky North Atlantic coasts in Europe and North America, with soft, branching fronds ranging from greenish-yellow to dark purple. It forms a jelly when boiled and is traditionally used fresh to thicken milk-based carrageen pudding in Scotland and Ireland.
output.edibilityNote: Traditionally used fresh as a thickener in carrageen pudding, a milk-based dish eaten in Scotland and Ireland.
